issues.title: [RX-9006] Qualify supported recovery paths with bounded evidence reuse
issues.body:
<!-- raveldex:RX-9006:start -->
**Task:** RX-9006 · **Milestone:** [N10](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/93) · **Status:** done

**Objective**

Reconcile existing recovery evidence and close essential current-candidate support/atomicity gaps only; distinguish successful recovery from safe refusal without requiring a fresh exhaustive statistical run.

**Dependencies**

[RX-9003](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/96)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] RX-9006-AC01: Map existing browser/worker, source/positions and receipt evidence to the actual unchanged candidate and explicitly declared supported sizes/options; preserve separate methods, incomplete rows and adverse outcomes.
- [x] RX-9006-AC02: Each advertised host/provider recovery combination has a demonstrated ordinary successful nonempty roundtrip and independent source/query/offset checks; a safely refused configuration is labeled limited/unsupported, never successful recovery.
- [x] RX-9006-AC03: Independent deterministic/real-host evidence covers prior-state preservation, forced deadline/abort, commit versus Unknown delivery, subsequent writes and disposal; unresolved material contract failures block the affected claim.
- [x] RX-9006-AC04: Any essential gap collection is predeclared, current-candidate only, at most eight representative contexts and at most 60 minutes including a ten-minute closing reserve, with effective per-context bounds; no automatic retry or hidden full matrix.
- [x] RX-9006-AC05: The old 146/204 collection and separate 22-context preflight remain separately scoped; neither is promoted to full coverage. The 450-minute extended comparison is optional and unexecuted unless separately requested.
- [x] RX-9006-AC06: A reviewed support-envelope and limitation report distinguishes qualification from statistical speed/p95, retained-heap and platform claims; completion records actual evidence under the November 7 amendment rather than rewriting old outcomes.

**Verification**

- Read and independently map already-produced evidence first; do not rerun passing unchanged runtime/fixture/method coverage simply because planning prose or a Git SHA changed.
- When essential coverage is missing, define the smallest new dated qualification case set and exact expected source/results/receipt checks before running. Keep existing native call limits and preserve every refusal or unrun case.
- Use one primary toolchain/candidate verification only when relevant runtime/test/build inputs change; documentation-only reconciliation uses planner/generated/link/preservation checks.
- Record the support/coverage decision and any new execution in a separately dated RX-9006 scoped closeout; keep old report/raw artifacts untouched and add only actual evidence before marking done.

- `bench/n9/`
- `test/adapters/`
- `docs/evaluation/`
- `docs/evidence/`

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] RX-9007-AC01: Independent review maps runtime/source identities, complete measured cohorts, qualification cases and adverse/missing outcomes; it never pools incompatible runs or interprets incomplete recovery data as a full benchmark.
